core_obligations: Record that a finite free module is reflexive (proof lines 5319-5321).
Use the cited sequence lemma to obtain the implication from condition (2) to condition (1) (proof lines 5321-5323).
Assume M reflexive, choose a presentation of its dual by free modules and dualise it to obtain an exact sequence whose kernel is the double dual (proof lines 5323-5329).
Identify the kernel with M by reflexivity and observe that the cokernel is torsion free as a submodule of a free module, giving condition (2) (proof lines 5329-5330).
proof_roadmap: (2) implies (1) by the cited sequence lemma (proof lines 5321-5323).
(1) implies (2) by dualising a presentation of the dual (proof lines 5323-5330).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises reflexive finite modules over a Noetherian domain by the existence of a presentation by a finite free module with torsion free cokernel, and the proof is a 12-line argument that first records that a finite free module is reflexive and then constructs the required sequence from a dual presentation. In the construction it takes a presentation of the dual of M, dualises it to a sequence whose kernel is the double dual of M, identifies the double dual with M by reflexivity, and observes that the cokernel is a submodule of a free module and hence torsion free. The dualisation step and the identification of the terms are both displayed.
